question: At build time, you want static HTML that includes data loaded with Suspense. Which API fits?
say: At build time, you want static HTML that includes data loaded with Suspense. Which API fits?
explanation: prerender waits for all Suspense boundaries before resolving, so the data is in the HTML. renderToString doesn't wait: it outputs fallbacks. hydrateRoot runs on the client.
explainSay: Pre render. It waits for all Suspense data before it resolves.
